title: Southern California HOA Community
summary: See how Airgain Lighthouse extended 5G coverage across a challenging Brea hillside community, improving connectivity at all five measured locations.
body_markdown:
A 687-home master-planned residential community spanning approximately 800 acres in Brea, California, had targeted areas with weak or little usable cellular service. Reliable connectivity was increasingly important to connected infrastructure across the property, including 27 cloud-connected license plate recognition (LPR) cameras and water-monitoring systems.


Velos Internet & Tech deployed the **Airgain Lighthouse™ 5G Intelligent Node** to extend an existing 5G signal into hard-to-reach areas without building a new cellular site.


Field testing showed improved cellular performance at **all five measured locations** . Two locations with no usable data service gained measurable 5G connectivity, including approximately **140 Mbps** at one location. Initial installation and commissioning were completed in **less than 1.5 days** despite challenging hillside conditions.
